justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-gradle-plugin/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/gradle/ByteBuddySimpleTaskExtension.java`, `AbstractByteBuddyTaskExtension.java`, and `ByteBuddySimpleTask.java`. The target class is only 89 LOC and contains one field plus seven short methods (constructor, getter/setter, and four overrides), all focused on a single concern: wiring a discovery set into `ByteBuddySimpleTask`. The broader configuration responsibilities live in `AbstractByteBuddyTaskExtension`, so this class is a thin specialization rather than an under-decomposed multi-responsibility class.
